messages:
emma_support: hi @liam — saw your ticket about a 403 on the project console for atlas-prod. can you confirm the affected user email and when this started?
liam_customer: it's connor@example.com. started after we updated our org handle earlier today. he used to be Project Owner. buttons are greyed out, 403 on page load.
emma_support: thanks. we changed the org handle at ~02:15 UTC and ran a SCIM sync. i'll pull logs.
noah_eng: @emma_support i'll check effective-role bindings. sometimes cached MV doesn't pick up SCIM changes after an org-handle change. can you share the user's external id or sub claim?
emma_support: sub: 00uabc123def; external_id: connor@acme.com
noah_eng: running admin API:
```
GET /v1/admin/organizations/ORG_ID/effective-roles?subject=00uabc123def
```
noah_eng: api shows no project binding for atlas-prod. SCIM audit shows the user was filtered during the group prune step (reason: email_domain_mismatch).
sara_idp: we normalized domains as part of the migration — some users had secondaryEmails that matched old domain. connor's primary email is connor@example.com but SCIM used external_id connor@acme.com and our filter excluded that domain.
liam_customer: so he's in the group in the IdP but got dropped during mapping?
noah_eng: looks like it. workaround is to either re-add via SCIM with the correct external_id or grant the project role directly in the console. i'll try a cache refresh after re-adding.
emma_support: re-added connor to prod-admins group via SCIM with corrected external_id.
liam_customer: re-added but still 403 for connor.
noah_eng: ok doing cache refresh:
```
POST /v1/admin/organizations/ORG_ID/refresh-role-cache
{"subjects": ["00uabc123def"]}
```
noah_eng: api returned 200, status queued.
scim-bot: SCIM sync completed: 14 users added, 1 filtered-out (connor@acme.com) reason=email_mismatch
noah_eng: scim-bot shows filtered event earlier — i re-ran mapping with explicit external_id mapping so it shouldn't filter now. re-triggered refresh.
noah_eng: cache job finished, effective-roles shows Project Owner for atlas-prod now.
emma_support: can you confirm with the customer?
liam_customer: confirmed — connor can access atlas-prod and UI is no longer greyed. :tada:
liam_customer: thanks team. can you share root cause and steps to avoid?
noah_eng: root cause: SCIM mapping filter excluded the user after org-handle change (domain normalization vs external_id mismatch) combined with a stale materialized view of effective-role bindings. remediation steps: 1) update SCIM mapping to prefer external_id or secondaryEmails where appropriate; 2) run a full SCIM resync after org-handle changes; 3) call refresh-role-cache for critical subjects post-migration; 4) add a smoke check that verifies sample project owners can access console after migrations. i'll open a follow-up ticket.
emma_support: filed TKT-5432 to update docs + add smoke test. emailed customer with root cause and mitigation. closing thread.
